ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; the visible ventral surface is approximately 95% low-intensity (black) with sparse high-intensity (white) focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black contiguous pigmentation across the entirety of the visible surface. Approximately 15-20 discrete, high-contrast white circular spots (pixel clusters) are scattered non-uniformly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees; deep vertical depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher amplitude jaggedness with a significant deep indentation 2/3 toward the tip; left lobe exhibits more frequent, lower-amplitude peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve along the trailing edge leading to elongated, acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 12 localized white circular clusters on the left lobe and 8 on the right lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe, interrupting the expected serration frequency.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense accumulation of white high-contrast pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
